Claim 281 (currently amended): A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of a medial section and are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer positioned between the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

Claim 282 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the additional adhesive layer is oriented in registration with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

Claim 283 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a plurality of cutting segments attached to the outer perimeter of the lamination.

Claim 284 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section includes a honeycomb structure.

Claim 285 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein a weld ring is at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

Claim 286 (currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous and bonded to the medial section.

Claim 287 (currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

Claim 288 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the tool has a circular shape. 

Claim 290 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a central opening in the medial section for accommodating a drive shaft.

Claim 291 (currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the medial section includes an inner ring, and the inner ring includes a central opening.

Claim 293 (currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is segmented and at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments. 

Claim 294 (currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.
